exposure: treatment for ADHD at any time
no known ADHD or stimulant treatment
Stimulant treatment for ADHD (dexamphetamine or methylphenidate)
Timing of stimulant treatment (before, before and during, and only after pregnancy)
cohort: 5056 women treated for ADHD with stimulant medication and a comparison cohort of 25280 women with no known ADHD or stimulant treatment, matched by maternal age and infant year of birth
finding: Compared with no treatment, ADHD stimulant treatment at any time was associated with small increases in the risk of some adverse pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: Stimulant treatment for ADHD was associated with reduced likelihood of spontaneous labor and increased risk of caesarean delivery.
